features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Small cylindrical sensor unit for discreet indoor surveillance
Detachable 8 m cable to the main unit
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_f1004_1509955_en_1604.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. PDF retrieved via the Wayback Machine archived copy. Datasheet lists no minimum illumination.
